status.label: Covered by the linked Ctrl-key tracking issue
status.detail: The author cross-linked this report as the same as #35445; a maintainer closed #35445 as duplicate of #35404, then closed #35404 as duplicate of #34714. #34714 remains open and contains current 0.100.2 confirmations.

judgment.rationale: The author of #35772 explicitly posted the same left-Ctrl hijack report on #35445 and called it the same issue. A maintainer closed #35445 as a duplicate of #35404, and later closed #35404 as a duplicate of #34714, the still-open tracking thread for Ctrl becoming stuck/disabled after Keyboard Manager remapping. #34714 has current 0.100.2 reports, including a detailed intermittent RDP reproduction, so this issue should be consolidated there rather than receive a parallel fix proposal. #35772 itself has no maintainer duplicate closure, so this is a coverage judgment, not a claim that its issue state was changed.
evidence: The author reports left Ctrl stops working after using remapped shortcuts or waking from standby; disabling and re-enabling Keyboard Manager temporarily restores it.
On #35445, the same author explicitly wrote “Same as: CTRL(left) key hijack #35772.”
A maintainer closed #35445 as a duplicate of #35404, describing the same periodic Ctrl failure.
A maintainer subsequently closed #35404 as a duplicate of #34714, which remains open.
The current #34714 thread includes a PowerToys 0.100.2 report with an intermittent RDP/focus-transition reproduction and additional current-build confirmations.
judgment.recommended_action: Use #34714 as the tracking thread; do not start a parallel fix from this duplicate report.

fix_assessment.rationale: The maintainer-directed duplicate chain consolidates this Ctrl-hijack symptom into still-open #34714, which has more current reproduction evidence. No separate issue-specific fix is needed here.

issue_context.summary: Left Ctrl periodically stops working while Keyboard Manager is enabled; the same author linked this as the same issue tracked in #34714.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.86.0 and says the left Ctrl key becomes unusable after time or standby while right Ctrl continues to work.
Disabling and re-enabling Keyboard Manager temporarily restores the key.
The author explicitly cross-linked this symptom to #35445, whose maintainer duplicate chain resolves to #34714.
Open #34714 contains current 0.100.2 reports of the same left-Ctrl failure and a more detailed intermittent reproduction.
inferences: The exact trigger in #35772 may differ from other reporters, but the shared stuck/disabled-Ctrl symptom is tracked in #34714.
issue_context.analysis: The direct author cross-link and two maintainer duplicate decisions provide a concrete tracking path. Keep the report associated with the open #34714 investigation and avoid asking for overlapping logs or proposing competing code work.
